editionData.title: Flood risks hamper efforts to search for hundreds missing at Nepal-China border; Iceland eyes hookup with European Union after...
editionData.description: Global headlines: Flood risks hamper efforts to search for hundreds missing at Nepal-China border (At least 540 people have been killed and more than 1,500 are reported missing in the Himalayan region as authorities race to find survivors after devastating flash floods); Iceland eyes hookup with European Union after Trump’s grab for Greenland (Iceland will decide whether to restart talks on joining the European Union in a referendum on Saturday, with President Donald Trump's threat to annex Greenland a motivating factor); and Volkswagen CEO warns German workers of sweeping layoffs to come (The automaker, one of the nation’s biggest employers, could shed tens of thousands of jobs amid global market shifts driven by electrification, AI and autonomous driving). Markets leaned higher, with 6 of 7 tracked indexes up; Euronext 100 Index up 0.66% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: U.S. Sanctions Against the a/I Collective (Autistici/Inventati provides internet support to activists and collectives coming from the world of grassroot and social movements); "IT WoRKs BeTter in the App " (android Apps google rant · 1 comment · 500 words · Viewed ~354 times); and OpenAI: Migrating to HTTPX2 (The official Python library for the OpenAI API. Contribute to openai/openai-python development by creating an account on GitHub). Product Hunt features CrowdVolt (You're coming out tonight), Caddi (Agent that builds agents by only showing your work only once), and PageIndex (Accurate, trustworthy answers across professional documents).
